title: RecipeTin's Garlic Bread
steps: Preheat your oven to 200°C before beginning.
Cut the baguette in half horizontally, then slice almost completely through at 2cm intervals.
Thoroughly mix the softened butter, minced garlic, kosher salt, and chopped parsley together in a bowl.
Generously smear the garlic butter mixture over the cut sides, top, and outer edges of the bread.
Wrap the prepared bread tightly in aluminum foil and bake for 15 minutes until crispy.
Carefully unwrap the foil from around the hot bread and serve immediately while warm.
